title: Inguinal fascial layers
view: Right groin in cross-section at the inguinal crease, patient supine, seen from the feet: lateral on the image left, medial on the right, skin at the top.
teachingPoint: The target plane is deep to the fascia iliaca, on the iliacus, lateral to the femoral nerve - not above the fascia with the vessels, and not in the muscle.
claims: Right groin, transverse, seen from the feet: lateral left, medial right, skin at the top.
Superficial to deep: skin, subcutaneous fat, fascia lata, fascia iliaca, iliopsoas; femoral head deep.

Femoral vein medial to the artery, both superficial to the fascia iliaca. Femoral nerve deep to the fascia iliaca, on the iliopsoas, lateral to the artery. Sartorius lateral within the fascia lata; pectineus deep to the vein.

Needle in-plane from lateral, entering lateral to the nerve and artery; tip under the fascia iliaca, lateral to the nerve. Teal: spread in the plane between fascia iliaca and iliacus, toward the nerve.
Three labels: Fascia iliaca, Femoral nerve, Femoral artery.
